name: The pipe field and the candles (station 5; biomes/gills/PLAN.md section 11 item 4 and section 18.2): the lowest White Gills (Wāiṭ Gīl) at 3,746 m and 1.00 atm, a dead gill closed by the tide's shift of the swarm with its hundreds of bone-white brucite pipes standing silent, fallen ones across the floor and rubble fans of broken rings; beside it the dry gills whose gas burns, blue candle flames (Qãḍal) a metre tall at the throats with a black heat crust round each; the History Monks' hermitage cut into a fallen pipe's base, the caravan stop at the salt cups, the Geomancers' capped gas-house and the caravans' smelting hearths, all published as sites and none of them built; the dark arch-rift-basalt colonnade scarp behind and the Catch's white floor far below to the north. Set in autumn at dusk, on the out-breath
